extracted.name: Banana-tahini Eton mess
extracted.description: Combine meringue, cream, tahini, bananas and salted caramel to make this quick dessert that's a twist on Eton mess. It's the perfect no-cook pudding for summer
instruction_lines: Whisk the double cream, tahini and icing sugar to soft peaks. Layer the tahini cream into dessert glasses with the sliced bananas, crushed meringue nests and salted caramel sauce. Sprinkle over the sesame seeds to serve.
